avoid_for: Conversion-hungry SaaS funnels needing loud filled CTAs, dark-mode-first products, playful consumer brands, or data-dense dashboards — the whispered serif, 95%-neutral palette, and one blue border can't carry urgency or high information density.
best_for: AI research / venture / co-founder-match sites and literary-brand storytelling pages that want a contemplative, journal-like register — hand-painted illustration plus quiet serif display, warm parchment, Stripe/Anthropic-adjacent.
name: General Intelligence Company
palette_voice: A warm book-page canvas: Parchment (#fefffc) page ground, Paper (#ffffff) cards, Linen (#f9faf7) inputs, green-tinted Mist (#dee2de) hairlines, near-black Graphite (#2c2c2c)/Charcoal (#444141) text (never pure #000); Signal Blue (#41a1cf) is a border-only CTA accent and Cerulean (#0081c0) a rare saturated card surface — the only two chromatic moments; color is 95% absent so hand-painted illustrations carry emotion; elevation is hairline borders plus subtle backdrop-blur, never box-shadow on buttons.
signature_moves: Frosted navigation pill — floating top-center, rgba white + backdrop-blur(9-20px), 50px pill radius, 1px twilight border — lets the illustrated hero show through
Full-bleed hand-painted atmospheric illustrations (moonlit skylines, wildflower meadows) as the emotional work, with UI living on clean white between scenes
Border-only CTA in Signal Blue (#41a1cf) at 8px radius — no fill, no shadow, the chromatic border is the button's entire identity
Green-tinted 1px Mist (#dee2de) hairline borders on cards — the signature edge treatment that harmonizes with the illustrations
Cerulean (#0081c0) saturated card surface as a lone punctuation moment of color intensity

source.radius: 4-8px buttons / 12-16px cards / 24px large surfaces / 50px nav pill
source.shadow: subtle rgba(0,0,0,0.08) 0 1px 1px / 0 4px 5px cards; nav uses backdrop-blur, not box-shadow

typographic_voice: A custom display serif (ppmondwest, subst. Fraunces/Recoleta) speaks at 48-54px weight 400 with tight -0.04em tracking — a low, literary, set-not-typed voice; a quiet custom sans (af, subst. Inter/Geist) handles all utilitarian UI at 13-18px with slight -0.01em negative tracking; body line-height 1.5 vs display 1.1; no weight 600+ on the serif, no serif below 27px, sans never used for display.
